description: Local businesses of one type in one city whose Google Maps listing shows no website: up to 10 of them (name, address, rating; phone numbers are masked), plus the share of sampled listings without a website. Useful for finding businesses that may need a website. When a city or business type is not covered, the result lists what is.

business_type.description: Type of business, for example "Dentist", "Roofing contractor" or "Plumber".

country.description: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Germany or Egypt. Optional.

region.description: State, province or county, for example "Texas", "TX" or "Greater London". Optional.

name: find_businesses_without_website
title: Businesses without a website
